title: Why do you jerk awake as you fall asleep?
caption:
Ever been drifting off… then your whole body JUMPS? 😳 It's called a hypnic jerk and about 7 in 10 people get them. As your muscles relax, your brain can mistake it for falling — so it panics and tells you to grab on! Totally normal. Caffeine, stress and being overtired make it happen more.

Do you get these? 👇
